senses.title: A regular sum for a purpose
senses.definition: a fixed sum of money paid regularly to someone for a particular purpose, such as travel or housing
senses.definitionCN: 为某一用途定期付给某人的固定款项，如交通或住房
senses.example: The company pays a travel allowance to staff who work away from home.
senses.exampleCN: 公司给在外地工作的员工发放差旅津贴。
senses.why: Allow first meant to allot a portion; the noun names that allotted portion, and when the portion is paid regularly for a stated purpose it becomes an allowance.
senses.whyCN: allow 最初有「分出一份」的意思；名词就指分出的那一份，当这一份是按期支付、用途固定时，就成了「津贴、补助」。

senses.title: Pocket money for a child
senses.definition: a small sum of money given to a child regularly, usually by a parent
senses.definitionCN: 定期给孩子的一小笔钱，通常由父母给
senses.example: He saves half of his weekly allowance for a new bicycle.
senses.exampleCN: 他把每周零花钱的一半存起来，想买辆新自行车。
senses.why: This is the allotted portion at its smallest and most personal: the parent marks off a share and hands it over, and the child may spend it.
senses.whyCN: 这是「分出一份」最小、最贴近生活的形态：父母划出一小份交给孩子，由孩子自己花用。

senses.title: A permitted amount
senses.definition: the amount of something that is officially permitted, such as weight, luggage or time
senses.definitionCN: 官方允许的数量，如重量、行李或时间
senses.example: Each passenger has a baggage allowance of twenty kilos.
senses.exampleCN: 每位乘客的行李限额是二十公斤。
senses.why: Permission measured becomes a quantity: the verb allows up to a limit, and the noun is that limit turned into a figure you can weigh.
senses.whyCN: 把「准许」量化，就成了一个数目：动词允许到某个界限，名词就是把这个界限变成一个可以称量的数字。

senses.title: An amount free of tax
senses.definition: an amount of income that is not taxed, or that may be earned before tax is paid
senses.definitionCN: 不需纳税的收入额度，或在缴税前可以赚到的额度
senses.example: Every taxpayer receives a basic personal allowance.
senses.exampleCN: 每位纳税人都享有基本个人免税额。
senses.why: The tax office allots a tax-free portion before it starts to count income: the permitted amount is money the state agrees to leave alone.
senses.whyCN: 税务部门在开始计算收入之前先划出一份免税的额度：这个被允许留下的数目，就是国家同意不去动的那部分钱。

senses.title: A reduction in price
senses.definition: a sum taken off a price, often for a trade-in, a fault or an old debt
senses.definitionCN: 从价格中减去的金额，常因以旧换新、瑕疵或旧账而给
senses.example: The dealer offered a generous allowance for the old car.
senses.exampleCN: 车商为那辆旧车给了一笔可观的折价。
senses.why: The allotted portion now moves the other way: instead of money paid out to you, it is money the seller agrees not to charge.
senses.whyCN: 分出的那一份这次朝反方向走：不是付给你的钱，而是卖方同意不收的那部分钱。

senses.title: In the phrase make allowance for
senses.definition: in the phrase make allowance for, to take a difficulty or a fault into account and judge less harshly
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 make allowance for，指把困难或过失考虑进去，从宽判断
senses.example: We should make allowance for the fact that she is still learning.
senses.exampleCN: 我们应当体谅她还在学习这一点。
senses.why: To allow is to leave room; making allowance for someone is leaving room in your judgment for their circumstances, so the noun turns into a mild, human form of permitting.
senses.whyCN: allow 就是留出余地；为某人 make allowance，就是在判断里为他的处境留出余地，于是这个名词变成一种温和、带人情味的「允许」。

intro.en: Allowance is not a Latin noun handed down whole: English built it from its own verb allow plus the suffix -ance, on a pattern already present in Old French.
intro.cn: allowance 不是原封不动传下来的拉丁语名词：它是英语用自己的动词 allow 加后缀 -ance 造出来的，而这一构词模式在古法语中已存在。

items.en: The Latin verbs allaudare 'to praise' and allocare 'to allot' stand behind the verb; only the second supplies the idea of a portion.
items.cn: 拉丁语动词 allaudare「称赞」与 allocare「分配」是那个动词的来源；其中只有后者提供了「一份」的概念。

items.en: Old French alouer carried approval and allotment together, and a related noun aloance is recorded with the sense of approval and allocation.
items.cn: 古法语 alouer 同时带着认可与分配两层意思，相关的名词 aloance 有记录，义为认可与分配。

items.en: English borrowed the verb as allowen, and the sense to allot a share was already alive in Middle English.
items.cn: 英语借入这个动词作 allowen，而「分出一份」的意思在中古英语时期就已经存在。

items.en: The noun allowaunce appears in the fourteenth century, formed with -ance; exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 名词 allowaunce 见于十四世纪，由后缀 -ance 构成；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The noun splits into money senses and measuring senses: a sum paid regularly, pocket money, a permitted amount, a tax-free part, a price reduction, and the phrase make allowance for.
items.cn: 这个名词分成「钱」与「量」两条线：定期给付的款项、零花钱、允许的数量、免税部分、减价，以及短语 make allowance for。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same allow family and one that merely resembles it; the near-meaning group gathers sums, limits and reductions that allowance can name.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 allow 词族的词，以及一个只是长得像的词；近义组收 allowance 可能指称的款项、额度与减价。

entries.definition: The verb that allowance is built from, meaning to permit, to set aside or to grant.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「允许、留出、给予」，正是 allowance 由之构成的动词。

entries.definition: Permitted by rules or by law, especially of costs and claims.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可允许的、法定的」，多用于费用与索赔。

entries.definition: To refuse to allow a claim, a goal or a piece of evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「驳回、判为无效」，用于索赔、进球或证据。

entries.definition: Distant and unfriendly; it only looks and sounds a little like allowance, and the origin is different.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「冷淡的、疏远的」，只是拼写与读音略近，词源与 allowance 不同。

entries.definition: Money paid by a government to support a service or a price; wider and more official than allowance.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「补贴」，由政府出资支持某项服务或价格，比 allowance 更宽、更官方。

entries.definition: A fixed regular payment, especially to a student, a priest or an intern.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「定期津贴」，多指发给学生、神职人员或实习生的固定款项。

entries.definition: A fixed share or a maximum number officially allowed; close to the permitted-amount sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「配额、定额」，指固定的份额或官方允许的上限，与「限额」义最近。

entries.definition: Money returned after a payment, close to the reduction sense of allowance.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「退款、回扣」，与 allowance 表示「折让」的义项接近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real history of the suffix -ance and the fixed phrases the noun actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用后缀 -ance 的真实来历，以及这个名词实际出现的固定搭配。

normal.en: Allow plus -ance makes a noun of the act: what is allowed becomes a thing you can count.
normal.cn: allow 加 -ance 把动作变成名词：被允许的东西成了一个可以计数的物件。

normal.en: The oldest layer is allotment, so an allowance is always a portion marked off in advance.
normal.cn: 最古老的一层是「分配」，所以 allowance 永远是一份事先划出来的份额。

normal.en: Housing allowance and travel allowance are sums paid for a stated purpose.
normal.cn: housing allowance 与 travel allowance 是为明确用途支付的款项。

normal.en: Baggage allowance measures weight, tax allowance measures untaxed income: the same word for two kinds of limit.
normal.cn: baggage allowance 量的是重量，tax allowance 量的是免税收入：同一个词管两种上限。

normal.en: Make allowance for is the human phrase: leave room in your judgment for someone's difficulty.
normal.cn: make allowance for 是最有人情味的用法：在判断里为别人的难处留出余地。

abstract.en: Picture a small stack of notes set apart on a table, already promised to one purpose.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上单独放着一小叠钱，早已许诺给某一个用途。

abstract.en: The stack can also be a weight on a scale: a figure that says how much may pass.
abstract.cn: 这一叠也可以是秤上的一个重量：一个说明能放过去多少的数字。

abstract.en: And it can be empty space in a judgment, the room you leave for someone who is still learning.
abstract.cn: 它还可以是判断里的空白，是你留给一个仍在学习的人的余地。

examples.en: The company pays a travel allowance to staff who work away from home.
examples.cn: 公司给在外地工作的员工发放差旅津贴。

examples.en: Each passenger has a baggage allowance of twenty kilos.
examples.cn: 每位乘客的行李限额是二十公斤。

examples.en: We should make allowance for the fact that she is still learning.
examples.cn: 我们应当体谅她还在学习这一点。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额老恩斯」——老人按月数出一小叠，只准用在该用的地方：津贴、限额。

root: 由动词 allow 加名词后缀 -ance 构成，最早见于中古英语；allow 出自古法语 alouer，一般认为混合了拉丁语 allaudare「称赞、认可」与 allocare「分配、划拨」。因此 allowance 的核心是「被分出来、被允许的那一份」。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses all name a portion that has been marked off: money paid for a purpose, pocket money, a permitted weight, a tax-free amount, a price reduction, and the room left for someone in a judgment.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项都在说一份被划出来的份额：为某用途支付的钱、零花钱、允许的重量、免税的额度、减去的价，以及判断中为别人留下的余地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small stack of money is set apart in advance and promised to one purpose.
core.cn: 核心意象：一小叠钱被事先分出来，许诺给某一个用途。

branches.en: THE PURSE: a portion is paid out regularly, to a worker or to a child.
branches.cn: 钱袋线：一份钱被定期付出，给员工，也给孩子。

branches.en: THE SCALE: permission is turned into a weight or a number that may not be passed.
branches.cn: 秤线：准许被换算成一个不能越过的重量或数字。

branches.en: THE TAX OFFICE: part of the income is allotted and left untaxed.
branches.cn: 税务线：收入中有一部分被划出，不去征税。

branches.en: THE PRICE: the portion moves the other way and is money the seller does not charge.
branches.cn: 价格线：这一份朝反方向走，成为卖方不收的那部分钱。

branches.en: THE JUDGMENT: the same room is left for a person's difficulty rather than for weight or money.
branches.cn: 判断线：同样的余地留给一个人的难处，而不是留给重量或金钱。

intro.en: Allowance is an English noun made from a borrowed verb; the suffixes that build its family are ordinary English endings.
intro.cn: allowance 是由借来的动词构成的英语名词；扩展这一词族的后缀都是普通的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verbs behind allow are recorded, while the noun allowance itself is an English formation built on the French pattern.
latinIntro.cn: allow 背后的拉丁语动词都有记录，而 allowance 这个名词本身是英语按法语模式造出来的。

items.example: It opens both allaudare and allocare.
items.exampleCN: 它同时出现在 allaudare 与 allocare 的开头。

items.example: It supplies the approving side of the family.
items.exampleCN: 它为这个词族提供「认可」的一面。

items.example: It supplies the allotting side of the family.
items.exampleCN: 它为这个词族提供「分配」的一面。

items.example: English took its verb from this form.
items.exampleCN: 英语的这个动词就来自这个形式。

items.example: Allow is the base of the noun.
items.exampleCN: allow 是这个名词的基础词。

items.example: It forms allowance from the verb.
items.exampleCN: 它加在动词后构成 allowance。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb from ad- plus laudare
Latin verb from ad- plus locare

derivatives.zh: 本词的基础动词，义为「允许；留出；给予」
由同一动词加后缀 -able 构成，义为「可允许的；法定的」
由否定前缀 dis- 加同一动词构成，义为「驳回；不准」

definition_zh: 倾倒；丢弃；倾销；垃圾场；甩掉（某人）；转储（数据）
definition_en: to drop or unload something heavily, to get rid of something unwanted, to sell goods abroad very cheaply, a place where waste is tipped, or to transfer data to storage
core_image: 卡车掀起车斗，一堆碎石轰然落在空地上
scene: 卡车在空地中央掀起车斗，碎石顺着斜坡倾泻而下。 They dumped the sand beside the road.
sceneCN: 这里 dump 是「倾倒」（第 1 个义项：把大量东西重重卸下）；句意是他们把沙子倒在了路边。

pos.zh: 动词：倾倒；丢弃；倾销；甩掉；转储
名词：垃圾场；堆放处；转储

derivatives.zh: 由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「自卸车；倾倒者」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「倾倒；倾销」
由本词加 -ster 构成，义为「大型垃圾箱」

senses.title: To drop or unload heavily
senses.definition: to drop, tip or unload a large amount of something in one place, often quickly and without care
senses.definitionCN: 把大量东西一下子倒、卸在某一处，常迅速而不加整理
senses.example: They dumped the sand beside the road.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把沙子倒在了路边。
senses.why: The word began as the sound and motion of a heavy fall, so the first picture is a load leaving a cart all at once.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初就是重物落下的声音与动作，所以第一个画面是一车货一下子离开车厢。

senses.title: To get rid of something
senses.definition: to get rid of something unwanted, especially in a careless or illegal way
senses.definitionCN: 把不要的东西处理掉，尤指随意或非法地
senses.example: Someone had dumped old tyres in the river.
senses.exampleCN: 有人把旧轮胎扔进了河里。
senses.why: What is tipped out of sight is also out of mind, so unloading becomes a way of discarding.
senses.whyCN: 倒到看不见的地方，也就从心里消失了，于是「卸下」变成了「丢弃」。

senses.title: To sell abroad cheaply
senses.definition: to sell goods in another country at a price far below what they cost or below the local price
senses.definitionCN: 以远低于成本或低于当地价格的价格在别国出售商品
senses.example: The company was accused of dumping steel on the European market.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司被指控向欧洲市场倾销钢材。
senses.why: Dumping goods is like tipping a load: the surplus is pushed off into another market to protect the home price.
senses.whyCN: 倾销就像倒货：把过剩的东西推进另一个市场，以保住本国的价格。

senses.title: A place for waste
senses.definition: a place where rubbish, waste or unwanted material is tipped and stored
senses.definitionCN: 倾倒并堆放垃圾、废物或废弃材料的地方
senses.example: The old dump has been turned into a small park.
senses.exampleCN: 那座旧垃圾场已被改造成一个小公园。
senses.why: The verb's destination becomes a noun: the place where loads are regularly tipped.
senses.whyCN: 动词的去处变成了名词：卡车经常倾倒货物的那个地方。

senses.title: To end a relationship abruptly
senses.definition: to end a romantic relationship with someone suddenly and without much explanation
senses.definitionCN: 突然且不加解释地结束与某人的恋爱关系
senses.example: She dumped him after two months.
senses.exampleCN: 两个月后她把他甩了。
senses.why: A person treated as unwanted baggage is 'dumped' at the roadside, and the informal sense follows that image.
senses.whyCN: 被当作不要的行李丢在路边的人，就是被 dump 了，口语义正是顺着这个意象来的。

senses.title: To transfer data
senses.definition: to copy a large amount of data from a computer's memory to storage or another system
senses.definitionCN: 把大量数据从计算机内存复制到存储设备或另一系统
senses.example: The program dumped the whole database to a backup drive.
senses.exampleCN: 程序把整个数据库转储到了备份盘上。
senses.why: Computing borrowed the image of tipping out a container: memory is emptied into storage all at once.
senses.whyCN: 计算机借用了「倒空容器」的意象：内存被一次性倒进存储设备。

intro.en: Dump is probably an imitative word for a heavy fall; its later senses all branch from the image of a load tipped out.
intro.cn: dump 很可能是一个模仿重物落下的词；后来的义项都从「一车货被倒出」这个意象分出来。

items.en: The word is often felt to echo a dull heavy thud, though this cannot be proved.
items.cn: 人们常觉得这个词回响着沉闷的重击声，但这一点无法证实。

items.en: A verb meaning to fall or throw down heavily is recorded in Middle English, with an uncertain earlier history.
items.cn: 中古英语有表示「重重落下或扔下」的动词记录，其更早的历史不确定。

items.en: To dump came to mean tipping a load out of a cart or barrow in one movement.
items.cn: to dump 逐渐指把一车货一次性地从推车或车厢里倒出。

items.en: Mining and industry fixed the noun dump for a tip or waste heap, and trade gave the word its dumping sense.
items.cn: 采矿与工业把名词 dump 固定为堆放场或废石堆，贸易则赋予它「倾销」义。

items.en: The informal sense of ending a relationship and the computing sense of copying data appear in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 口语中「甩掉恋人」与计算机中「复制数据」的义项，都出现在二十世纪。

items.en: Data dump, rubbish dump and dump someone show one image spread across very different fields.
items.cn: data dump、rubbish dump 与 dump someone 展示了同一个意象跨越了极不同的领域。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on dump; the near-meaning group separates discard, tip and throw away by register and image.
note.cn: 形近组收由 dump 构成的词形；近义组按语体与意象区分 discard、tip 与 throw away。

entries.definition: A vehicle that tips its load, or a person who dumps something; dump plus -er.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指自卸车或倾倒者，由 dump 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: The act of tipping waste, or the trade practice of selling abroad cheaply.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指倾倒废物的行为，或低价向国外销售的做法。

entries.definition: A large metal container for waste; dump plus the noun suffix -ster.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指大型金属垃圾箱，由 dump 加名词后缀 -ster 构成。

entries.definition: A small mass of dough cooked in water; it looks similar but has a separate origin.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「汤团、饺子」，外形相近但来源不同。

entries.definition: To throw something away as no longer wanted; more formal and deliberate than dump.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「丢弃」，比 dump 更正式、更有意为之。

entries.definition: To empty a container by turning it over; the physical action behind dump.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「倾倒、翻倒」，是 dump 背后的物理动作。

entries.definition: To get rid of something by putting it in the rubbish; general and neutral.
entries.definitionCN: 动词短语，义为「扔掉」，通用而中性。

entries.definition: To remove goods from a vehicle; it stresses the removal, not the waste.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「卸货」，强调搬下货物，而非当作废物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the sound and motion of a tipped load, then follow it into waste, trade, love and computing.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子守住一车货被倒出时的声音与动作，再跟着它走进垃圾、贸易、感情与计算机。

normal.en: Dump sounds like the thud of a load hitting the ground.
normal.cn: dump 的发音就像一车货砸在地上的闷响。

normal.en: The verb is regular: dump, dumped, dumped, dumping.
normal.cn: 这个动词是规则的：dump、dumped、dumped、dumping。

normal.en: A rubbish dump is the place where loads are tipped again and again.
normal.cn: a rubbish dump 就是一车车货被反复倒下的地方。

normal.en: Dumping goods abroad is tipping a surplus into another market.
normal.cn: dumping goods abroad 就是把过剩的货倒进另一个市场。

normal.en: To dump someone is to treat a person like unwanted baggage at the roadside.
normal.cn: to dump someone 就是把一个人当作路边不要的行李。

abstract.en: Picture a lorry with its bed raised, and a grey stream of gravel sliding out.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆抬起车斗的卡车，一条灰色的碎石流从中滑落。

abstract.en: The same tipping motion reappears as a trash heap, a cheap export deal and a memory emptied onto a disk.
abstract.cn: 同一个倾倒动作又以垃圾堆、廉价出口交易和内存倒入磁盘的形式重现。

abstract.en: Dump is always about unloading something fast, and the question is only onto what.
abstract.cn: dump 永远是把东西快速卸下，问题只在于卸到什么上面。

examples.en: They dumped the sand beside the road.
examples.cn: 他们把沙子倒在了路边。

examples.en: The truck dumped its load at the site.
examples.cn: 卡车在工地卸下了货物。

examples.en: The old computer was dumped in the yard.
examples.cn: 那台旧电脑被扔在了院子里。

dict_mnemonic.text: dump 像重物「咚」地落地：把货倒下来、把废物扔掉、把货低价倾销，都是同一个「倒」。

root: 中古英语有「重重落下、扔下」的动词记录，更早来源不确定，词形可能模仿重物落地声。十六至十七世纪指一次倒出一车货，十九世纪固定「垃圾场」与「倾销」义，二十世纪又出现「甩掉恋人」与「数据转储」义。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses of dump all keep one motion: a load tipped out of its container, whether the container is a truck, a market, a relationship or a computer's memory.
sensesIntro.cn: dump 的六个义项都保留同一个动作：一车货被倒出容器，无论这个容器是卡车、市场、一段感情还是计算机内存。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a truck bed rising, and a load sliding out onto the ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：卡车车斗抬起，一车货滑落到地上。

branches.en: THE LOAD: a heavy amount is tipped out in one movement.
branches.cn: 货物线：大量东西被一次性倒出。

branches.en: THE WASTE: what is unloaded is also what is unwanted.
branches.cn: 废物线：被卸下的东西同时也是不要的东西。

branches.en: THE MARKET: a surplus is tipped into another country at a low price.
branches.cn: 市场线：过剩货物以低价倒进另一个国家。

branches.en: THE PLACE AND THE PERSON: a tip becomes a dump, and unwanted baggage becomes a dumped partner.
branches.cn: 地点与人线：堆放处变成垃圾场，不要的行李变成被甩掉的恋人。

branches.en: THE DISK: memory is emptied into storage in one go.
branches.cn: 磁盘线：内存被一次性倒进存储设备。

intro.en: Dump is a native verb of uncertain origin; English adds -er, -ing, -ster and compounds with waste and data.
intro.cn: dump 是来源不确定的本族语动词；英语加 -er、-ing、-ster，并与 waste、data 等构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor; Latin effundere, to pour out, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语祖先；拉丁语 effundere（倒出）只是语义上的对应。

items.meaning: to fall or throw down heavily
items.example: The verb is the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是词族的基础。

items.meaning: a container or person connected with

items.exampleCN: 它出现在 waste dump 中。
它出现在 rubbish dump 中。
它出现在 data dump 中。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「自卸车；倾倒者」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「倾倒；倾销」
由本词加 -ster 构成，义为「大型垃圾箱」

definition_zh: 不太可能的；未必会发生的；不大可信的；（人）不像是真的
definition_en: not probable, or hard to believe when told
core_image: 一条窄路通向高处的城堡，看着就上不去
scene: 大家都以为他考不过，可他自己偷偷每天早起做题。 It is unlikely that he will fail.
sceneCN: 这里 unlikely 是「不大可能的」（第 1 个义项：发生机会小）；句意为他不太可能考不过。一条看着就上不去的窄路，正是这个词的核心画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉否定前缀的形容词，义为「可能的」
形容词加 -ness 构成名词，义为「不太可能」
由 likely 派生的名词，义为「可能性」
由 like 派生的名词，义为「相似」

senses.title: Not expected to happen
senses.definition: having little chance of happening or being true
senses.definitionCN: 发生或成立的可能性很小
senses.example: A change of plan this late seems unlikely.
senses.exampleCN: 这么晚再改计划看来不太可能。
senses.why: Like used to mean similar, and likely meant probable; removing that leaves little chance.
senses.whyCN: like 古义为「相似」，likely 意为「可能」，去掉这份相似，剩下的就是机会甚微。

senses.title: Used with a verb in the infinitive
senses.definition: used as be unlikely to plus a verb to say a thing will probably not happen
senses.definitionCN: 用作 be unlikely to 加动词，说明某事大概不会发生
senses.example: She is unlikely to arrive before ten.
senses.exampleCN: 她大概十点前到不了。
senses.why: Probability attached to a person turns into a prediction about that person actions.
senses.whyCN: 挂在人身上的「可能性」，就转成了关于此人行为的推测。

senses.title: Someone or something in the wrong place
senses.definition: used of a person or place that is surprising in a particular role
senses.definitionCN: 形容某人在某角色或某地出现得令人吃惊
senses.example: The old garage became an unlikely art gallery.
senses.exampleCN: 那间旧车库成了一个意想不到的画廊。
senses.why: A thing that does not resemble its expected role is literally unlike it.
senses.whyCN: 与预期角色不像的东西，字面上就是「不像」。

senses.title: Hard to believe when told
senses.definition: used of a story that is hard to accept as true
senses.definitionCN: 形容难以当作真事接受的叙述
senses.example: He told an unlikely story about a missed ferry.
senses.exampleCN: 他讲了个关于错过渡船的、不大可信的故事。
senses.why: What is improbable in fact is also improbable in belief, so one word serves both.
senses.whyCN: 事实上的不可能，与相信上的不可能本是同一回事，一个词就兼顾了。

senses.title: A pairing that should not work
senses.definition: used of partnerships or combinations that succeed against expectation
senses.definitionCN: 形容出人意料却奏效的搭档或组合
senses.example: Their unlikely friendship lasted forty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他们这段意想不到的友谊维持了四十年。
senses.why: Two things that resemble nothing of each other should not fit, yet here they do.
senses.whyCN: 彼此毫不相像的两样东西本不该合适，这里却恰好合适。

intro.en: Likely grew from like meaning similar, and un- was added to deny probability.
intro.cn: likely 由意为「相似」的 like 发展而来，un- 则用来否定其可能性。

items.en: Gelic meant having the same form, from a Germanic root for body or form.
items.cn: gelic 意为「形态相同」，词根在日耳曼语中指形体。

items.en: Likely first meant similar in appearance, then probable.
items.cn: likely 初指外貌相似，后转为「可能的」。

items.en: Un- was prefixed to likely for what is hardly expected.
items.cn: 在 likely 前加 un-，表示几乎不会被预期的事。

items.en: Be unlikely to became a fixed pattern for predictions.
items.cn: be unlikely to 成为固定预测句型。

items.en: Unlikely also describes people and places used in surprising roles.
items.cn: unlikely 也用来形容出现在意外角色中的人与地方。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the like family, and the near-meaning group gathers probability words.
note.cn: 形近组是 like 词族，近义组汇集表示可能性的词。

entries.definition: probable
entries.definitionCN: 可能的

entries.definition: different from
entries.definitionCN: 不像；与……不同

entries.definition: a resemblance
entries.definitionCN: 相似

entries.definition: hard to like
entries.definitionCN: 不讨人喜欢的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: not likely to happen
entries.definitionCN: 不大可能的

entries.definition: unlikely or uncertain
entries.definitionCN: 可疑的

entries.definition: hard to believe
entries.definitionCN: 难令人信服的

entries.definition: probable
entries.definitionCN: 可能的

normalIntro.en: The word denies resemblance: if things are not alike, the chance is small.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词否定的是「相似」：彼此不像，机会自然就小。

normal.en: Un- plus likely: not probable.
normal.cn: un- 加 likely：不大可能。

normal.en: Be unlikely to do is the pattern to remember for predictions.
normal.cn: be unlikely to do 是预测时需要记住的句型。

normal.en: Highly unlikely is the common intensifier.
normal.cn: highly unlikely 是常用的加强说法。

normal.en: Like also means similar, which explains the root.
normal.cn: like 还有「相似」之义，这解释了它的词根。

normal.en: An unlikely hero is a favourite phrase in news writing.
normal.cn: an unlikely hero 是新闻写作中的常用说法。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow path climbing to a castle that seems unreachable.
abstract.cn: 想象一条窄路通向看似上不去的城堡。

abstract.en: See two people who share no taste in anything, laughing together.
abstract.cn: 看两个毫无共同爱好的人一起大笑。

abstract.en: Hear a weather report promise snow in June.
abstract.cn: 听天气预报说六月有雪。

examples.en: It is unlikely that the shop will open on Sunday.
examples.cn: 这家店星期天不太可能开门。

examples.en: He is unlikely to agree without reading it first.
examples.cn: 不先读一遍，他不太可能同意。

examples.en: The station became an unlikely setting for an opera.
examples.cn: 火车站成了一个意想不到的歌剧舞台。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺来客利」——俺来客人了？这年月不太可能，怕是弄错了。

root: 前缀 un-（不）+ likely，likely 源自古英语 gelic（形态相同），词根在日耳曼语中意为「形体」，由「相似」转义为「可能的」

sensesIntro.en: One denied resemblance covers chance, prediction, surprising roles, shaky stories, and odd pairs.
sensesIntro.cn: 一次对「相似」的否定，覆盖几率、预测、意外的角色、可疑的故事与奇怪的组合。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow path climbing to a castle that looks unreachable.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条通向看似上不去的城堡的窄路。

branches.en: The chance branch: little likelihood of happening.
branches.cn: 几率分支：发生的可能很小。

branches.en: The prediction branch: people unlikely to act.
branches.cn: 预测分支：人们不太会做的事。

branches.en: The setting branch: a person or place in the wrong role.
branches.cn: 场景分支：出现在意料之外角色里的人或地。

branches.en: The belief branch: a story that will not convince.
branches.cn: 相信分支：说服不了人的叙述。

branches.en: The pairing branch: a match that should not work.
branches.cn: 组合分支：本不该合适的搭配。

intro.en: A negative prefix on an adjective that came from an old word for likeness.
intro.cn: 否定前缀压在一个源自「相似」古词的形容词上。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic rather than Latin, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，因此拉丁词条留空。

items.exampleCN: 想法相近的人所见略同。
like 加 un- 成为 unlike，意为不同。

items.example: An improbable win is still a win.
items.exampleCN: 不太可能的胜利也是胜利。

items.example: An implausible excuse convinced no one.
items.exampleCN: 一个难以信服的理由没能说服人。

items.example: It is doubtful the plan will work.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划能否奏效值得怀疑。

definition_zh: 碗柜；橱柜
definition_en: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves, used for dishes or food
core_image: 一扇木柜门打开，里面叠着碗和杯子
scene: 厨房里那扇木门一开，里面叠着碗和杯。 The plates are kept in the cupboard above the sink.
sceneCN: 这里 cupboard 指「碗柜」（第 1 个义项：带门和架子、用来放餐具的家具）；句意是盘子放在水槽上方的碗柜里。

senses.title: A storage cabinet
senses.definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for dishes or food
senses.definitionCN: 带门和架子、放餐具或食物的家具
senses.example: Put the bowls back in the cupboard.
senses.exampleCN: 把碗放回碗柜。
senses.why: Doors hide the clutter and keep dust out.
senses.whyCN: 柜门挡住杂乱，也挡住灰尘。

senses.title: A small closed space
senses.definition: a small closet built into a wall
senses.definitionCN: 嵌在墙里的小储藏空间
senses.example: The broom is in the cupboard under the stairs.
senses.exampleCN: 扫帚在楼梯下的壁橱里。
senses.why: A wall can hold a room no one counts.
senses.whyCN: 一堵墙里能藏一间没人算进去的小屋。

senses.title: A bare cupboard
senses.definition: a state of having no food or money left
senses.definitionCN: 食物或钱都已见底的状态
senses.example: After the long winter the cupboard was bare.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的冬天过后，柜子空了。
senses.why: An empty shelf tells a whole story.
senses.whyCN: 一格空架子就能讲完一个故事。

intro.en: Cupboard began as Middle English cuppebord, a board for cups, from cup and bord.
intro.cn: cupboard 原是中古英语 cuppebord，即放杯子的板，由 cup 与 bord 合成。

items.en: Cuppebord joined cup and bord, a board.
items.cn: cuppebord 由 cup 与 bord（板）合成。

items.en: It meant a sideboard for cups and plates.
items.cn: 它指放杯盘的边柜。

items.en: The word was shortened to cupboard.
items.cn: 这个词被缩短成 cupboard。

items.en: Cupboards gained doors and became closed.
items.cn: 碗柜装上柜门，成了封闭的家具。

items.en: It now means any cabinet for dishes or food.
items.cn: 如今它指任何放餐具或食物的柜子。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cup- opening, and the meaning group names other closed storage furniture.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cup- 开头，近义组列出其他封闭的储物家具。

entries.definition: a small container for drinking
entries.definitionCN: 喝水用的小容器

entries.definition: as much as a cupboard can hold
entries.definitionCN: 一柜子能装的量

entries.definition: a small cake baked in a paper cup
entries.definitionCN: 纸杯烤的小蛋糕

entries.definition: a piece of furniture with shelves and doors
entries.definitionCN: 带架子和门的家具

entries.definition: a small room for storing things
entries.definitionCN: 存放东西的小房间

entries.definition: a small cupboard that can be locked
entries.definitionCN: 可上锁的小柜子

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a board for cups and end with an empty shelf.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一块放杯子的板开始，落到一格空架子。

normal.en: Cup plus board: first a shelf, then a box.
normal.cn: cup 加 board：先是板，后来成了箱。

normal.en: Say it fast and the p disappears: cupboard.
normal.cn: 说快了那个 p 就不见了：cupboard。

normal.en: A cupboard keeps dust off and clutter out of sight.
normal.cn: 碗柜挡住灰，也把杂乱藏起来。

normal.en: The plates live above the sink, behind two small doors.
normal.cn: 盘子的家在水槽上方，两扇小门后面。

normal.en: When the cupboard is bare, the story turns sad.
normal.cn: 柜子一空，故事就变苦了。

abstract.en: Picture two small doors opening on stacked bowls.
abstract.cn: 想象两扇小门打开，里面叠着碗。

abstract.en: Picture a broom leaning in a dark closet.
abstract.cn: 想象一把扫帚靠在黑暗的壁橱里。

abstract.en: Picture one empty shelf with a single crumb.
abstract.cn: 想象一格空架子上只有一点面包屑。

examples.en: The sugar is in the cupboard on the left.
examples.cn: 糖在左边的碗柜里。

examples.en: He built a cupboard for the kitchen.
examples.cn: 他为厨房做了一个橱柜。

examples.en: The cupboard was bare by the end of the month.
examples.cn: 到了月底，柜子已经空了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cupboard 记成「放杯子的板」：cup 加 board（板），一块放杯子的板，后来装上柜门。

root: 中古英语 cuppebord 由 cup（杯子）与 bord（板）合成，原指放杯盘的板架；十六世纪缩为 cupboard，十七世纪装上柜门，遂指碗柜。

sensesIntro.en: From a board for cups, to a closed cabinet, to an empty shelf that tells a story.
sensesIntro.cn: 从放杯子的板，到带门的柜子，再到能讲故事的空气架。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wooden door opening on stacked bowls and cups.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇木门打开，里面叠着碗和杯。

branches.en: A cabinet holds dishes behind closed doors.
branches.cn: 柜子把餐具收在关着的门后。

branches.en: A cupboard can also be a small room in a wall.
branches.cn: cupboard 也可以是墙里的小空间。

branches.en: A bare cupboard means there is nothing left.
branches.cn: 柜子空了，意味着什么都不剩。

branches.en: A big cupboard and a small closet both hide things.
branches.cn: 大碗柜与小壁橱都在藏东西。

branches.en: What is hidden may be dishes, or may be hunger.
branches.cn: 藏起来的可能是餐具，也可能是饥饿。

intro.en: Cupboard sits in the cup family, and keeps the old sense of a board in its spelling.
intro.cn: cupboard 属于 cup 一族，拼写里还留着「板」的旧义。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cuppa, a drinking vessel, is the root behind cup and cupboard alike.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）是 cup 与 cupboard 共同的根。

items.example: The cupboard is full of bowls.

items.meaning: as much as a cupboard holds
items.example: They bought a cupboardful of rice.

items.meaning: affection shown for what one gets
items.example: The cat's purr was cupboard love.
items.exampleCN: 猫的呼噜是冲着食盆来的。

items.meaning: a small cake in a paper cup
items.exampleCN: 孩子吃了一个纸杯蛋糕。

items.example: The teacup has a thin handle.
The cup holder is beside the seat.

definition_zh: 意识到的；知道的；察觉到的
definition_en: knowing that something exists or is happening
core_image: 一个人忽然停下，侧耳听见远处的警笛
scene: 街角的行人同时抬起头。 Everyone was aware of the siren behind them.
sceneCN: 这里 aware 是「意识到的」（第 1 个义项：知道某事存在或正在发生）；句意是每个人都察觉到了身后的警笛声。

pos.zh: 形容词：意识到的；知道的；察觉到的

derivatives.zh: 由 aware 加 -ness 构成，义为「意识；认识」
由 aware 加 un- 构成，义为「未察觉的」
由 self 与 aware 复合而成，义为「有自我意识的」

senses.title: Knowing something exists
senses.definition: knowing that something exists or is happening
senses.definitionCN: 知道某事存在或正在发生
senses.example: Everyone was aware of the siren behind them.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人都察觉到了身后的警笛声。
senses.why: Aware is an old adjective from ware, watchful; to be aware is to have your attention on something.
senses.whyCN: aware 是古形容词 ware「警觉的」的变体；aware 就是注意力落在某物上。

senses.title: Informed about a fact
senses.definition: having knowledge of a fact or situation
senses.definitionCN: 掌握某个事实或情况
senses.example: Are you aware that the office closes early today?
senses.exampleCN: 你知道办公室今天提前关门吗？
senses.why: Watchfulness grows into knowledge, so aware also means having information, especially information others may not have.
senses.whyCN: 警觉会发展成知识，所以 aware 也指掌握信息，尤其是别人未必知道的信息。

intro.en: Aware began as a word for being watchful.
intro.cn: aware 最初表示「警觉的」。

items.en: wær meant 'cautious or watchful'.
items.cn: wær 意为「谨慎、警觉」。

items.en: gewær meant 'aware'.
items.cn: gewær 意为「觉察到的」。

items.en: aware kept the sense of being watchful.
items.cn: aware 保留了警觉之义。

items.en: aware shifted toward knowing.
items.cn: aware 转向「知道」。

items.en: Aware of is now the usual pattern.
items.cn: 如今常用 aware of 的结构。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the a- opening; the near-meaning group gives kinds of knowing.
note.cn: 形近组都以 a- 开头；近义组是表示知道与留心的词。

entries.definition: not asleep
entries.definitionCN: 醒着的

entries.definition: to give a prize officially
entries.definitionCN: 授予

entries.definition: to be on your guard
entries.definitionCN: 当心

entries.definition: noticing something in your mind
entries.definitionCN: 有意识的

entries.definition: careful to remember something
entries.definitionCN: 留心的

entries.definition: having facts about something
entries.definitionCN: 知情的

normalIntro.en: Aware is watchfulness turned into knowledge.
normalIntro.cn: aware 是警觉变成了知识。

normal.en: Aware of is the usual pattern, and aware that also works.
normal.cn: 常用 aware of，也可接 aware that。

normal.en: The noun is awareness, not aware.
normal.cn: 名词是 awareness。

normal.en: Unaware means not knowing.
normal.cn: unaware 意为不知道的。

normal.en: Aware is not used before a noun in most speech.
normal.cn: 多数口语中 aware 不放在名词前。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: a-WARE.
normal.cn: 重音在第二音节。

abstract.en: See a walker stopping and turning an ear.
abstract.cn: 想象行人停下脚步侧耳倾听。

abstract.en: See a light switching on in a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象暗房里一盏灯亮起。

abstract.en: See a hand raised to warn the person ahead.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手抬起提醒前面的人。

examples.en: Everyone was aware of the siren behind them.
examples.cn: 每个人都察觉到了身后的警笛声。

examples.en: Are you aware that the office closes early today?
examples.cn: 你知道办公室今天提前关门吗？

examples.en: She became aware of soft footsteps behind her.
examples.cn: 她察觉到身后有轻轻的脚步声。

dict_mnemonic.text: a- 加 ware（警觉）：眼睛和耳朵先醒过来，心里也就知道了。

root: 源自古英语 wær「谨慎、警觉」及其复合形式 gewær「觉察到的」，属日耳曼语系；由「警觉」引申为「知道、意识到」。

sensesIntro.en: Watchfulness and knowledge are two ends of the same attention.
sensesIntro.cn: 警觉与知识，是同一种注意力的两端。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an ear turning toward a distant sound.
core.cn: 核心意象：耳朵转向远处的声音。

branches.en: aware of danger
branches.cn: 意识到危险

branches.en: become aware
branches.cn: 开始察觉

branches.en: acutely aware
branches.cn: 深切意识到

branches.en: aware that the shop is closed
branches.cn: 知道商店关门了

branches.en: well aware of the rules
branches.cn: 很清楚规则

intro.en: The ware root, 'watchful', also gives beware, wary and awareness.
intro.cn: 词根 ware 意为「警觉」，也构成 beware、wary 与 awareness。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base here; the family is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这一族词来自日耳曼语。

items.meaning: to see or become aware of

definition_zh: 气候；氛围；形势
definition_en: the usual weather conditions of a place over a long period, or the general mood and conditions in a group or period
core_image: 同一片天空下年年重复的雨与晴
scene: 老人翻着几十年的农事笔记，记下每年第一场雨的日子。 The mild climate here suits tea and oranges.
sceneCN: 这里 climate 指「气候」（第 1 个义项：一个地方长期的天气状况）；句意是这里温和的气候适合种茶和柑橘。

senses.title: Long-term weather of a place
senses.definition: the usual weather conditions of a region over many years
senses.definitionCN: 一个地区多年间反复出现的天气状况
senses.example: The island has a warm climate and little snow.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛气候温暖，很少下雪。
senses.why: Greek geographers divided the world into belts by the angle of the sun, and each belt became a climate.
senses.whyCN: 希腊地理学家按日照角度把世界分成带，每一条带就叫一个气候区。

senses.title: The mood of a group
senses.definition: the general feeling or attitude among a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 一群人当中普遍的情绪或态度
senses.example: A climate of trust made the talks easier.
senses.exampleCN: 信任的氛围让谈判顺利了许多。
senses.why: Weather surrounds people and shapes their day, and so does a shared mood, which borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 天气包围并影响人的一天，共同的氛围也是如此，于是借用了同一个词。

senses.title: Conditions affecting decisions
senses.definition: the economic or political conditions that affect how people act
senses.definitionCN: 影响人们行动方式的经济或政治条件
senses.example: Few firms hire in such a poor climate.
senses.exampleCN: 在如此糟糕的形势下，很少有公司招人。
senses.why: Business writers needed a word for the surrounding conditions, and the weather word was ready.
senses.whyCN: 商业作者需要一个词表示周围的条件，天气词正好现成可用。

intro.en: Climate began as a Greek word for a slope, because the sun's angle decides how warm a region is.
intro.cn: climate 最初是希腊语中表示斜坡的词，因为日照角度决定了一个地区的冷暖。

items.en: Klima meant a slope or a zone of the earth.
items.cn: klima 指斜坡或地球上的一条地带。

items.en: Geographers used it for bands of the world marked by sun and slope.
items.cn: 地理学家用它指按日照与坡度划分的地带。

items.en: Clima kept the sense of a zone of the earth.
items.cn: clima 保留了地球地带的意思。

items.en: The word entered French as climat.
items.cn: 这个词以 climat 的形式进入法语。

items.en: English first used it for a region and its weather.
items.cn: 英语最初用它指一个地区及其天气。

items.en: The word widened to the mood of a group and the state of business.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到群体氛围与商业形势。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in spelling, while the meaning group covers weather, surroundings and shared mood.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的词，近义组涵盖天气、环境与共同情绪。

entries.definition: to move upward using hands and feet
entries.definitionCN: 手脚并用地向上移动

entries.definition: the most exciting or important point of a story
entries.definitionCN: 故事中最激动人心或最重要的时刻

entries.definition: an old poetic word for a region and its weather
entries.definitionCN: 古诗文中指某个地区及其天气

entries.definition: the condition of the air on a particular day
entries.definitionCN: 某一天空气的具体状况

entries.definition: the feeling that a place or event gives people
entries.definitionCN: 某个地方或事件给人的感觉

entries.definition: the conditions and surroundings in which people live
entries.definitionCN: 人们生活所处的条件与周围情况

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the sun's angle, the long record of weather and the mood of a meeting room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从日照角度、长期天气记录和会议室气氛入手。

normal.en: Climate and climb share a start: both look up at the sky.
normal.cn: climate 与 climb 开头相同：两者都抬头看天。

normal.en: Weather is today; climate is the average of many years.
normal.cn: weather 是今天，climate 是许多年的平均。

normal.en: The Greek klima meant a slope, because slope decides how much sun a place gets.
normal.cn: 希腊语 klima 意为斜坡，因为坡度决定一个地方得到多少阳光。

normal.en: The same word covers the room as well as the sky: a climate of trust.
normal.cn: 同一个词既能说天空，也能说房间：信任的氛围。

normal.en: Climatic keeps the adjective, climatology keeps the science.
normal.cn: climatic 是形容词，climatology 是这门学科。

abstract.en: Picture a globe marked with belts, hot at the middle and cold at the poles.
abstract.cn: 想象一个划成条带的地球，中间炎热，两极寒冷。

abstract.en: Picture a farmer's notebook full of rain dates across forty years.
abstract.cn: 想象一本农家笔记，记满四十年间的降雨日期。

abstract.en: Picture a quiet meeting room where everyone nods before speaking.
abstract.cn: 想象一间安静的会议室，人人发言前都先点头。

examples.en: The climate here is too dry for rice.
examples.cn: 这里的气候太干燥，不适合种稻。

examples.en: Climate change is reshaping the coast.
examples.cn: 气候变化正在改变海岸的面貌。

examples.en: The company expanded in a favourable economic climate.
examples.cn: 这家公司在有利的经济形势下扩张。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 climate 记成「斜坡上的天气」：坡向哪儿，阳光就怎么照，一方水土便有了脾气。

root: 源自希腊语 klima（斜坡、地带），经拉丁语 clima 与法语 climat 进入英语，本义是按日照划分的地带。

sensesIntro.en: From a band of the earth to the weather of a place, then to the mood around people and the state of trade.
sensesIntro.cn: 从地球上的地带，到一个地方的天气，再到人群氛围与商业形势。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slope of land under a particular angle of sun.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片土地在特定日照角度下形成的斜坡。

branches.en: The physical sense is the long weather record of one region.
branches.cn: 实义是一个地区长期的天气记录。

branches.en: A shared feeling wraps a group the way weather wraps a town.
branches.cn: 共同的感受笼罩一个群体，就像天气笼罩一座城。

branches.en: Economic conditions become a climate that firms must read.
branches.cn: 经济条件成了一种企业必须判读的气候。

branches.en: Both senses describe surroundings that people cannot easily change.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述人们不易改变的环境。

branches.en: Mood and market conditions are both the air a decision is made in.
branches.cn: 氛围与市场条件都是做决定时所处的空气。

intro.en: The stem climat carries the family, with adjective, adverb and scientific endings added.
intro.cn: 词干 climat 撑起家族，再添加形容词、副词与学科词尾。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek klima, a slope, which Latin took over as clima.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是希腊语 klima（斜坡），拉丁语把它接收为 clima。

items.meaning: more than one pattern of regional weather
items.example: The book compares climates on three continents.
items.exampleCN: 这本书比较了三大洲的气候。

items.example: Climatic zones shift as the earth warms.
items.exampleCN: 随着地球变暖，气候带发生移动。

items.example: The two ports are climatically similar.
items.exampleCN: 这两个港口在气候上相似。

items.example: She studied climatology for six years.
A climatologist explained the rainfall data.
items.exampleCN: 一位气候学家解释了降雨数据。

items.meaning: the climate of one small area
items.example: The valley has its own microclimate.
items.exampleCN: 这条山谷有自己的小气候。

items.meaning: not harmful to the global climate
items.exampleCN: 他们选择了对气候友好的供暖方式。

items.meaning: a long-term shift in global weather patterns
items.example: Climate change is a global issue.
items.exampleCN: 气候变化是一个全球性问题。

latinEntries.meaning: a zone or belt of the earth
latinEntries.example: Clima passed into French and then English.

definition_zh: 暗示；意味着；含有……意思
definition_en: to suggest something without saying it directly, or to be a natural sign of something
core_image: 说话人眼神扫过空椅子，然后停在门口
scene: 介绍人没提任何名字，只说了句「位置还空着」。 By saying the seat was empty, she implied that one of them was leaving.
sceneCN: 这里 imply 是「暗示」（第 1 个义项：不明说而让人领会），句意是她说座位空着，等于暗示其中一人要离开。画面里有扫过空椅子的眼神。

pos.zh: 动词：暗示、意味着、含有……的意思

senses.title: To suggest without saying
senses.definition: to make a listener understand something that is not spoken out
senses.definitionCN: 使听者领会未被说出的意思
senses.example: I did not mean to imply that you were wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 我并不想暗示你错了。
senses.why: The fold inside the Latin root explains it: the meaning is folded in, waiting to be opened by the listener.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根里的「折」正好解释：意思被折进去，等听者去展开。

senses.title: To be a sign of
senses.definition: used of facts which logically point to a further fact
senses.definitionCN: 用于事实在逻辑上指向另一事实的情况
senses.example: The empty shelves imply a shortage.
senses.exampleCN: 空着的货架意味着短缺。
senses.why: Things imply each other as well as people, when one fact cannot stand without another behind it.
senses.whyCN: 不仅人，事物之间也互相蕴含：当一个事实离开背后的事实便站不住时。

senses.title: To involve as a necessary part
senses.definition: to bring something with it as a necessary condition
senses.definitionCN: 必然附带某条件或结果
senses.example: Taking the job implies moving to another city.
senses.exampleCN: 接下这份工作就意味着搬到另一座城市。
senses.why: A consequence folded into an action is implied by that action, so the verb also marks necessary conditions.
senses.whyCN: 折在行动里的后果由该行动所蕴含，于是这个动词也标示必要条件。

intro.en: Imply comes from the Latin verb for folding in, and English shaped it through French implication.
intro.cn: imply 来自拉丁语「折入」动词，英语形式经法语影响而定形。

items.en: Plicare meant to fold, and implicare to fold one thing into another.
items.cn: 拉丁语 plicare 意为折叠，implicare 指把一物折进另一物。

items.en: French used emplier and later implied forms for wrapping a meaning inside words.
items.cn: 法语以 emplier 及后来的 implied 形式表示把含义包进言语。

items.en: English formed imply in the fourteenth century on the French model.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪仿法语模式造出 imply。

items.en: Logic gave the verb its technical sense: one statement implies another.
items.cn: 逻辑学赋予它专业义：一个陈述蕴含另一个陈述。

items.en: Everyday speech uses it constantly for polite hints and gentle accusations.
items.cn: 日常口语中它大量用于客气的暗示与委婉的指责。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the fold family; the near-meaning group separates the confusable suggesting verbs.
note.cn: 形近组收「折叠」词族；近义组分辨几个容易混淆的「提示」动词。

entries.definition: The hinted meaning itself, as a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 被暗示的意思本身，名词形式。

entries.definition: Folded in, understood without being stated.
entries.definitionCN: 折在其中、不待明说的。

entries.definition: To put to use, shaped like imply but from a different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 应用、申请，形式与 imply 相似但前缀不同。

entries.definition: What the listener does with a hint, while imply is what the speaker does.
entries.definitionCN: 听者从暗示中推出；imply 是说着做的，infer 是听者做的。

entries.definition: To put an idea forward softly; wider than imply.
entries.definitionCN: 柔和地提出想法，比 imply 范围更广。

entries.definition: To have as a meaning, the plainest word in the group.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「意思是」，这组里最朴素的词。

normalIntro.en: The hooks pair imply with infer, and unfold the fold image into a sentence.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把 imply 与 infer 配成一对，并把「折」的意象展开进句子里。

normal.en: The speaker implies, the listener infers; keep the direction straight.
normal.cn: 说者 imply，听者 infer，方向不能颠倒。

normal.en: Drop the e before -ed and -es: implied, implies.
normal.cn: -ed 与 -es 前要省掉 e：implied、implies。

normal.en: Two beats, stress the second: im-PLY.
normal.cn: 两个音节，重音在后：im-PLY。

normal.en: The plic fold hides inside, so the meaning is never on the surface.
normal.cn: '折'藏在里面，所以意思从不在表面上。

normal.en: As the name implies is a fixture of explanations and manuals.
normal.cn: as the name implies 是解释与手册里的常客。

abstract.en: The verb respects what silence can carry, since it lets a speaker act without saying.
abstract.cn: 这个动词尊重沉默所能承载的东西，让说者不必开口也能行动。

abstract.en: Facts imply too, and a good reader treats the world as a text folded in layers.
abstract.cn: 事实也会蕴含，好的读者把世界当作层层折叠的文本。

abstract.en: Accusations often travel through imply because it leaves no fingerprints.
abstract.cn: 指责常借 imply 传递，因为它不留指纹。

examples.en: The letter implies that the contract will not be renewed.
examples.cn: 这封信意味着合同不会续签。

examples.en: Are you implying that I made the mistake?
examples.cn: 你是在暗示是我的错吗？

examples.en: Silence does not imply agreement.
examples.cn: 沉默并不意味着同意。

dict_mnemonic.text: im 向内 + ply 折（plic 的变体）——把意思折进话里，不明说：暗示

root: 拉丁语 plicare「折叠」→ implicare「折入」，经法语影响，英语十四世纪造出 imply。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: a polite hint, a sign in facts, and a necessary consequence.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：委婉的暗示、事实上的迹象，以及必然伴随的后果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a speaker's glance at an empty chair, then at the door.
core.cn: 核心意象：说话人瞥向空椅，又看向门口。

branches.en: THE HINT LINE: I did not mean to imply that is a common repair phrase.
branches.cn: 暗示线：我无意暗示……是常见的补救话。

branches.en: THE CLUE LINE: empty shelves imply shortage.
branches.cn: 线索线：空货架意味着短缺。

branches.en: THE CONDITION LINE: a job implies moving.
branches.cn: 条件线：一份工作意味着搬迁。

branches.en: THE PARTNER LINE: imply needs an inferring mind at the other end.
branches.cn: 搭档线：imply 需要另一端有一个在推断的心。

branches.en: THE LOGIC LINE: both are about what must follow.
branches.cn: 逻辑线：两者都关乎必然跟着来的东西。

intro.en: Imply is the verb of the fold family, with a dropped letter in its past forms and a noun in -ation.
intro.cn: imply 是「折叠」家族的动词，过去形式要省字母，名词以 -ation 收尾。

latinIntro.en: Implicare is Latin; the English verb was reshaped through French spelling habits.
latinIntro.cn: implicare 属拉丁语；英语动词形式受法语拼写习惯重塑。

items.example: Import begins with the same prefix.
Reply and apply use the same shape.
items.exampleCN: reply 与 apply 形式相近。
这一结果意味着更多工作。
这名字意味着年头很久。

items.example: She implied nothing of the kind.
He was implying more than he said.

items.exampleCN: 规则里明确写了这一点。

definition_zh: 大蒜；大蒜植株；蒜味
definition_en: a strong-smelling bulb used in cooking, the plant that grows it, or the taste it gives food
core_image: 案板上剥好的几瓣大蒜
scene: 汤里有一股大蒜味。 The soup smells of garlic.
sceneCN: 这里 garlic 是「大蒜」（第 1 个义项）；句意：汤里有一股大蒜味。

senses.title: Edible bulb
senses.definition: a bulb with a strong taste and smell that is used in cooking
senses.definitionCN: 味道和气味浓烈、用于烹饪的鳞茎
senses.example: The soup smells of garlic.
senses.exampleCN: 汤里有一股大蒜味。
senses.why: This is the sense cooks use most often.
senses.whyCN: 这是烹饪者最常用的义项。

senses.title: Garlic plant
senses.definition: the plant that produces garlic bulbs
senses.definitionCN: 长出蒜头的那种植物
senses.example: Garlic grows well in loose soil.
senses.exampleCN: 大蒜在疏松的土壤里长得好。
senses.why: The same word names the living plant.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也指活的植株。

senses.title: Garlic taste
senses.definition: the strong taste or smell that garlic gives to food
senses.definitionCN: 大蒜给食物带来的浓烈味道或气味
senses.example: The sauce has a hint of garlic.
senses.exampleCN: 这酱汁有一点蒜味。
senses.why: The substance word also names its flavour.
senses.whyCN: 表示物质的词也指它带来的味道。

intro.en: Garlic is an Old English compound that describes a spear-shaped leek.
intro.cn: garlic 是古英语复合词，描述形状像矛的韭葱。

items.en: Garleac joined gar, meaning spear, and leac, meaning leek.
items.cn: garleac 由意为矛的 gar 和意为韭葱的 leac 组成。

items.en: The name described a plant with spear-shaped leaves.
items.cn: 这个名字描述叶片形似长矛的植物。

items.en: The spelling settled as garlic.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 garlic。

items.en: It became a common kitchen seasoning.
items.cn: 它成为常见的厨房调料。

items.en: The word also came to name the taste itself.
items.cn: 这个词也开始指味道本身。

note.en: Garlic is compared with look-alike words and other strong kitchen plants.
note.cn: 把 garlic 与形近词以及其他气味浓烈的厨房植物作比较。

entries.definition: a circle of flowers worn or hung as decoration
entries.definitionCN: 花环

entries.definition: to wash the throat with liquid
entries.definitionCN: 漱喉

entries.definition: a piece of clothing
entries.definitionCN: 衣服

entries.definition: a round vegetable with a strong taste
entries.definitionCN: 洋葱

entries.definition: a long green vegetable related to the onion
entries.definitionCN: 韭葱

entries.definition: a small mild onion
entries.definitionCN: 红葱头

normalIntro.en: Garlic is a small bulb that makes its presence known in the kitchen.
normalIntro.cn: garlic 是一种在厨房里存在感很强的小鳞茎。

normal.en: The soup smells of garlic.
normal.cn: 汤里有一股大蒜味。

normal.en: Add one clove of garlic to the oil.
normal.cn: 往油里加一瓣大蒜。

normal.en: She spread garlic butter on the bread.
normal.cn: 她把蒜香黄油抹在面包上。

normal.en: Garlic grows well in loose soil.
normal.cn: 大蒜在疏松的土壤里长得好。

normal.en: The sauce has a hint of garlic.
normal.cn: 这酱汁有一点蒜味。

abstract.en: Garlic teaches that a small thing can fill a whole room.
abstract.cn: 大蒜说明小东西也能充满整个房间。

abstract.en: Strong flavours are remembered longer than mild ones.
abstract.cn: 浓烈的味道比清淡的味道被记得更久。

abstract.en: What we cook with quietly becomes part of us.
abstract.cn: 我们用来烹煮的东西会悄悄成为自己的一部分。

examples.en: The soup smells of garlic.
examples.cn: 汤里有一股大蒜味。

examples.en: Garlic grows well in loose soil.
examples.cn: 大蒜在疏松的土壤里长得好。

examples.en: The sauce has a hint of garlic.
examples.cn: 这酱汁有一点蒜味。

dict_mnemonic.text: garlic 可拆成 gar（矛）和 leac（韭葱）两部分；a clove of garlic 是「一瓣大蒜」，garlic bread 是「蒜蓉面包」。

root: 古英语 garleac，由 gar（矛）和 leac（韭葱）组成，因叶片形似长矛而得名。

sensesIntro.en: Garlic is the edible bulb, the plant that grows it, or the strong taste it adds to food.
sensesIntro.cn: garlic 指可食用的鳞茎、长出它的植株，或它给食物添的浓烈味道。

core.en: A pungent bulb that flavours food.
core.cn: 给食物调味的辛辣鳞茎。

branches.en: A bulb is peeled and chopped.
branches.cn: 蒜头被剥开切碎。

branches.en: Green leaves rise from the soil.
branches.cn: 绿叶从土里长出来。

branches.en: Its heat lingers on the tongue.
branches.cn: 它的辛辣留在舌头上。

branches.en: The bulb and the flavour it gives cannot be separated.
branches.cn: 蒜头与它带来的味道无法分开。

branches.en: The kitchen bulb and the field plant are one word.
branches.cn: 厨房里的蒜头和地里的植株是同一个词。

intro.en: Garlic builds words for its flavour, dishes, and tools.
intro.cn: garlic 构成表示蒜味、菜肴和工具的词。

latinIntro.en: The word is Old English, not Latin, but it is built from two older Germanic parts.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是古英语词而非拉丁语词，但它由两个更早的日耳曼语成分构成。

items.example: Garlic keeps well in a dry place.

definition_zh: 准备；预备；配制品；（复数）筹备工作
definition_en: the act of making something or someone ready, or a substance made ready for a particular use
core_image: 厨房案板上一排切好的食材、一张写满步骤的纸，锅还没上火
scene: 这场考试的准备工作比考试本身花的时间还长。 Preparation for the exam took longer than the exam itself.
sceneCN: 这里 preparation 是「准备工作、预备」（第 1 个义项：使事情就绪的过程）；句意：备考所花的时间比考试本身还长。图中可辨识物件：切好的食材、步骤纸、尚未点火的锅；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 准备；预备；配制品；筹备工作

senses.title: Making ready
senses.titleCN: 准备：把事情弄成就绪状态
senses.definition: the process of getting something or someone ready for what is to come
senses.definitionCN: 使某物或某人就绪以应对将来之事的过程
senses.example: Preparation of the venue began three days early.
senses.exampleCN: 场地准备工作提前三天开始。
senses.why: prae- 'before' plus parare 'make ready' gives praeparare, 'to make ready beforehand'. The noun names that before-work.
senses.whyCN: prae-“在前”加 parare“使就绪”构成 praeparare“预先使就绪”，名词命名这件“提前做的事”。

senses.title: The state of readiness
senses.definition: the condition of being ready, considered as a result rather than an activity
senses.definitionCN: 已经就绪的状态，被视为结果而非活动
senses.example: The troops were in preparation for a night march.
senses.exampleCN: 部队正处于夜行军的准备状态。
senses.why: The same -ation noun can name the result as well as the process, so preparation can be a state one is in.
senses.whyCN: 同一个 -ation 名词既可命名过程也可命名结果，所以 preparation 也可以是一种所处的状态。

senses.title: Study beforehand
senses.definition: work done in advance to learn or to be able to teach a subject
senses.definitionCN: 为学会或能够讲授某科目而提前做的工夫
senses.example: Her lesson preparation takes two hours a night.
senses.exampleCN: 她每晚备课要花两个小时。
senses.why: Teaching turns preparation into a private, daily task: the teacher must be ready before the class exists.
senses.whyCN: 教学把准备变成私人的日常功课：课还不存在时，老师就得先就绪。

senses.title: A medicinal preparation
senses.definition: a substance, especially a medicine or cosmetic, compounded into a usable form
senses.definitionCN: 调配成可用形态的物质，尤指药物或化妆品
senses.example: The pharmacy makes a preparation for dry skin.
senses.exampleCN: 这家药房配制一种用于干性皮肤的制剂。
senses.why: Pharmacists prepare mixtures, so the product of that work took the name of the work. A preparation is readiness made tangible.
senses.whyCN: 药剂师调配混合物，于是产物沿用了动作的名字。制剂就是被做成实物的“就绪”。

senses.title: Laboratory preparation
senses.titleCN: 实验室制备：把样本弄成能看的样子
senses.definition: the treatment of a specimen or chemical so that it can be examined or used
senses.definitionCN: 对标本或化学品进行处理，使其可被观察或使用
senses.example: Slide preparation must be done within an hour of sampling.
senses.exampleCN: 玻片制备必须在采样后一小时内完成。
senses.why: In the lab the word names a technical routine: tissue, soil or a compound is made ready for the instrument.
senses.whyCN: 在实验室里，这个词命名一套技术流程：组织、土壤或化合物被做成适合仪器的样子。

senses.title: Food preparation
senses.titleCN: 食品加工：把原料做成饭
senses.definition: the cleaning, cutting and cooking of food before it is eaten
senses.definitionCN: 食物食用前的清洗、切配与烹制
senses.example: Food preparation areas must be kept separate from toilets.
senses.exampleCN: 食品加工区必须与卫生间分开。
senses.why: Cooking is preparation in the oldest sense: raw material is made ready to be consumed.
senses.whyCN: 烹饪是最古老意义上的准备：原料被做成可以入口的样子。

senses.title: Music: preparing a dissonance
senses.titleCN: 音乐：为不协和音做铺垫
senses.definition: in counterpoint, the earlier sounding of a note that will later form a dissonance
senses.definitionCN: 对位法中，某音先以协和状态出现，随后才构成不协和
senses.example: The suspension needs a preparation in the preceding chord.
senses.exampleCN: 延留音需要在前面和弦中有铺垫。
senses.why: Music theory borrowed the everyday word literally: the ear is prepared for the clash by hearing the note first in peace.
senses.whyCN: 乐理字面借用了日常词：先让耳朵在协和中听到该音，为后面的冲突做准备。

senses.title: Arrangements, plural
senses.definition: the practical arrangements made in advance, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 提前做出的一项项实际安排，通常用复数
senses.example: The wedding preparations filled the whole summer.
senses.exampleCN: 婚礼筹备占满了整个夏天。
senses.why: Countable plural preparations names the individual items of the before-work: bookings, lists, orders.
senses.whyCN: 可数复数 preparations 命名提前工作中的一件件具体事项：预订、清单、订单。

intro.en: Preparation comes from Latin praeparare 'to make ready beforehand', from prae- 'before' plus parare 'make ready, furnish'. The noun is praeparatio.
intro.cn: preparation 来自拉丁 praeparare“预先使就绪”，由 prae-“在前”加 parare“使就绪、置办”构成，名词为 praeparatio。

items.en: parare meant 'to make ready, prepare, furnish'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; it is generally connected with a PIE root *pere- 'to produce, procure', which should be labelled as generally believed rather than certain.
items.cn: parare 意为“使就绪、预备、置办”。其更深来源不确定，一般认为与原始印欧语词根 *pere-“产出、取得”有关，应标“一般认为是”而非确定。

items.en: prae- 'before' plus parare produced praeparare, 'to get ready in advance'. The prefix adds time, not place.
items.cn: prae-“在前”加 parare 构成 praeparare“提前弄好”。前缀加的是时间，不是地点。

items.en: The action noun praeparatio named both the act of readying and the state of being ready.
items.cn: 动作名词 praeparatio 既指“使就绪的行为”，也指“已就绪的状态”。

items.en: English borrows preparation in the 1300s through French, first in religious writing about preparing the soul.
items.cn: 英语在 14 世纪经法语借入 preparation，最早见于关于心灵预备的宗教写作。

items.en: From the 16th century a preparation is also a compound made ready by an apothecary, which is why the word can name a medicine.
items.cn: 16 世纪起，preparation 也指药剂师配好的复方，因此这个词可以命名一种药。

items.en: In modern English the word covers exam study, food handling, lab routines and event arrangements, all sharing the same before-work.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词覆盖备考、食品处理、实验室流程与活动筹备，共享同一件“提前做的事”。

note.en: The look-alike group shares par- or the pre- prefix; the near-meaning group also involves getting ready but differs in what is being readied.
note.cn: 形近组共享 par- 或 pre- 前缀；近义组也涉及就绪，差别在“让什么就绪”。

entries.definition: to make ready. The verb is the act; the noun is the act or its product.
entries.definitionCN: 准备。动词是动作，名词是动作或其产物。

entries.definition: introducing or leading up to something main. It describes position in a sequence, not the work itself.
entries.definitionCN: 预备的；作为前导的。它描述顺序中的位置，而非准备工作本身。

entries.definition: a public procession. It comes from French parade 'display', from parer 'to adorn, arrange', a different branch of parare's sense range.
entries.definitionCN: 游行；阅兵。来自法语 parade“展示”，源于 parer“装饰、布置”，是 parare 词义范围中的另一分支。

entries.definition: the state of being prepared. It names only the condition, while preparation can also name the activity.
entries.definitionCN: 就绪状态。它只命名状态，而 preparation 还能命名活动。

entries.definition: the way things are put in order, or the plans made. It stresses organisation rather than readiness.
entries.definitionCN: 安排；布置。强调组织，而非就绪。

entries.definition: long instruction to build skill. It is preparation for a role, but it names the skill-building, not the readying.
entries.definitionCN: 训练。它是为某角色做的准备，但命名的是技能培养，而非就绪。

entries.definition: the basic work that makes later work possible. It is a kind of preparation, but stresses foundation.
entries.definitionCN: 基础工作。它是准备的一种，但强调打地基。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: pre- 'before' plus parare 'make ready' gives the whole idea: ready made before it is needed.
normal.cn: pre-“在前”加 parare“使就绪”，整个意思就出来了：在需要之前先弄好。

normal.en: The family prepare, prepared, preparatory, preparation all keep the par- stem.
normal.cn: prepare、prepared、preparatory、preparation 全族保留 par- 词干。

normal.en: A medicinal preparation is the pharmacist's work turned into a bottle.
normal.cn: 药物制剂就是药剂师的工作变成一瓶东西。

normal.en: In preparation for is the most common frame and always points forward in time.
normal.cn: “为……做准备”是最常见的框架，永远指向未来的时间。

normal.en: The opposite state is unprepared, which is simply readiness missing.
normal.cn: 反面的状态是 unprepared，就是“就绪”缺席。

abstract.cn: 想象演出前一晚的舞台：灯亮着，台上没人。

examples.en: The lab keeps a preparation of the enzyme at four degrees.
examples.cn: 实验室在四摄氏度下保存该酶的制剂。

examples.en: Most of the work was preparation, not performance.
examples.cn: 大部分工作是准备，而不是表演。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe work done before the main event, sometimes the work and sometimes what the work produced.

branches.cn: 行为与状态：preparation 命名过程以及它带来的就绪。

branches.en: DAILY READYING: lesson preparation and food preparation are both private, repeated before-work.
branches.cn: 日常就绪：备课与备餐都是私人的、反复的提前功夫。

branches.en: MADE SUBSTANCE: a medicine and a microscope slide are the noun's product side.
branches.cn: 制成之物：药剂与玻片是这个词的产物面。

branches.en: MUSIC: counterpoint prepares the ear for a clash by sounding the note first in peace.
branches.cn: 音乐：对位法先让音在协和中出现，为耳朵预备冲突。

branches.en: PLANS: countable preparations are the individual arrangements of the before-work.
branches.cn: 计划：可数复数指提前工作中的一件件安排。

intro.en: Preparation is prae- plus parare plus -ion. The prefix marks 'before', the verb marks 'readying', and the suffix turns it into a noun of action or result.
intro.cn: preparation 由 prae- 加 parare 加 -ion 构成。前缀标记“在前”，动词标记“使就绪”，后缀使其成为动作或结果名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin line is parare 'make ready' → praeparare 'prepare' → praeparatio 'a preparing'. English also keeps the adjective stem in preparatory.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁线为 parare“使就绪”→ praeparare“准备”→ praeparatio“预备”。英语还在 preparatory 中保留形容词词干。

senses.title: A hard part of the skeleton

definition_zh: 移开；去除；消除；免职；搬迁
definition_en: to take something away from a place or get rid of it
core_image: 把碍事的一把椅子从过道上端走
scene: 医生小心地把纱布揭下来，看了看伤口愈合得怎么样。 The nurse carefully removed the bandage to check the wound.
sceneCN: 这里 remove 是「取下、移开」（第 1 个义项：把某物从原处拿走）；句意：护士小心地取下绷带，查看伤口。

pos.zh: 移开；去除；消除；免职；搬迁

derivatives.zh: remove 加 -al 构成，义为「移走；去除」
remove 加 -able 构成，义为「可拆卸的」
remove 加 -ed 构成，义为「远离的；隔代的」

senses.title: To take something away from a place
senses.definition: to lift or carry something out of the place where it was
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从原来的位置搬起或带离
senses.example: Please remove your bag from the seat.
senses.exampleCN: 请把包从座位上拿开。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to move back, so the core image is a thing being moved out of the way.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「向后移」，所以核心画面是东西被移出了原来的位置。

senses.title: To get rid of something
senses.definition: to clean away or put an end to something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 清除或终结某种不想要的东西
senses.example: This spray removes grease from the oven.
senses.exampleCN: 这种喷剂能去除烤箱上的油污。
senses.why: Once a thing is carried out of the way, it is gone, which is the sense of getting rid of it.
senses.whyCN: 东西一旦被搬到别处就消失了，这正是「去除」义。

senses.title: To dismiss someone from a position
senses.definition: to force a person out of a job or an official role
senses.definitionCN: 迫使某人离开职位或官方岗位
senses.example: The council voted to remove the mayor.
senses.exampleCN: 议会投票决定罢免市长。
senses.why: A person is moved out of a post the way an object is moved out of a room.
senses.whyCN: 人被移出职位，与物件被移出房间是同一个动作。

senses.title: To move to another place
senses.definition: to go with one's household to live somewhere else, in formal or literary use
senses.definitionCN: 带着家当另居他处，属正式或文学性用法
senses.example: The family removed to the countryside in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人在春天迁往乡下。
senses.why: Moving a whole household away from one address is the same verb applied to people instead of things.
senses.whyCN: 整个家庭从一处住所移走，就是同一个动词用在人而不是物上。

intro.en: Remove comes from Old French remouvoir, from Latin removere, built on re- and movere, to move.
intro.cn: remove 来自古法语 remouvoir，源自拉丁语 removere，由 re- 与 movere「移动」构成。

items.en: Removere means to move back or away, from re- and movere.
items.cn: removere 意为向后移开或移走，由 re- 与 movere 构成。

items.en: Movere is also behind motion, motive, and mobile.
items.cn: movere 也是 motion、motive 与 mobile 的词源。

items.en: Remouvoir means to move away, to take away, and to delay.
items.cn: 古法语 remouvoir 表示移开、拿走以及推迟。

items.en: English remove first covers physical taking away and dismissal from office.
items.cn: 英语 remove 最初同时涵盖物理上的拿开与免职。

items.en: The formal sense of moving house survives mainly in writing and in the adjective removed.
items.cn: 迁居的正式义项主要残存于书面语以及形容词 removed 之中。

note.en: Remove is the verb at the centre of the removal family, and remote is its distant participle.
note.cn: remove 是 removal 词族的中心动词，remote 则是它表示「远方」的分词。

entries.definition: the act of taking something away
entries.definitionCN: 移走；去除，由 remove 加 -al 构成

entries.definition: able to be taken off easily
entries.definitionCN: 可拆卸的，由 remove 加 -able 构成

entries.definition: far away in distance
entries.definitionCN: 遥远的，与 remove 同出拉丁语 removere

entries.definition: to carry something off from where it is
entries.definitionCN: 拿走；带走，口语常用

entries.definition: to remove written or stored material
entries.definitionCN: 删除，多用于文字与数据

entries.definition: to remove completely
entries.definitionCN: 消除；淘汰，语气更强

normalIntro.en: Remove and its family all sit on the movere root of moving things out of the way.
normalIntro.cn: remove 及其词族都立于 movere 词根之上，意为把东西移开。

normal.en: Re- plus movere gives moving something back and out of the way.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 movere，就是把东西往后移开。

normal.en: The adjective removed also means far apart, as in a cousin twice removed.
normal.cn: 形容词 removed 还表示「隔得远」，如 twice removed 指隔两代。

normal.en: Remove a stain and remove doubt work with the same verb but different objects.
normal.cn: remove a stain 与 remove doubt 用同一个动词，只是对象不同。

normal.en: Removal, removable, and remover all build on the verb.
normal.cn: removal、removable、remover 都由这个动词构成。

normal.en: The magnet phrase remove the barrier pairs well with abstract obstacles.
normal.cn: remove the barrier 这个搭配很适合形容抽象障碍。

abstract.en: Picture a chair lifted out of a narrow aisle so people can pass.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子被从窄过道端走，人们才能通过。

abstract.en: See a hand peeling a label off a jar.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把标签从罐子上揭下来。

abstract.en: Think of a name being wiped from a list on a board.
abstract.cn: 想黑板名单上的一个名字被擦掉。

examples.en: Please remove your shoes before entering.
examples.cn: 进门前请脱鞋。

examples.en: The new evidence removed all doubt.
examples.cn: 新的证据消除了所有疑问。

examples.en: The judge was removed from the case.
examples.cn: 这位法官被撤出了该案。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞木屋」——想象瑞丽的木屋被整个搬走，地面空了出来；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 remouvoir，源自拉丁语 removere（re-「向后」+ movere「移动」）。

sensesIntro.en: Moving a thing away produces taking away, clearing away, removing a person from a post, and moving house.
sensesIntro.cn: 把东西移开，衍生出拿走、清除、把某人移出职位以及搬家四个义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chair carried out of a narrow aisle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把椅子从窄过道被端走。

branches.en: Carrying a thing away from its place is the base act.
branches.cn: 把东西从原位带走是基础动作。

branches.en: Once carried away, dirt and doubt are gone.
branches.cn: 污垢与疑虑一旦被带走，就消失了。

branches.en: A person can be carried out of a post the same way.
branches.cn: 人也可以用同样方式被带离职位。

branches.en: A household moves itself away from one address.
branches.cn: 家庭把自己从一处住所移走。

branches.en: Physical removal and its result share one motion.
branches.cn: 物理上的移开与它带来的结果共享同一个动作。

intro.en: Remove is a French verb shaped from a Latin prefix and a Latin motion root.
intro.cn: remove 是由拉丁前缀与拉丁移动词根塑造出的法语动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back and movere means to move, so remove means to move something back or out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「向后」，movere 表示「移动」，因此 remove 意为把东西移开。

items.example: Re- gives the direction of removal.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 给出移开的方向。

items.example: The mov- root is shared with removable.
items.exampleCN: mov- 词根与 removable 共用。

items.example: Movere is the source of motion and motive.
items.exampleCN: movere 是 motion 与 motive 的来源。

items.example: Removal names the act of removing.
Removable means able to be taken off.
items.exampleCN: removable 意为「可以被取下的」。

items.example: Removere is the direct Latin ancestor.
items.exampleCN: removere 是直接的拉丁祖先。

items.example: Mobile keeps the movere root in an adjective.
items.exampleCN: mobile 把 movere 词根保留在形容词中。

definition_zh: 在旁边；到一边；撇开；留着；（戏剧）旁白；题外话
definition_en: to or on one side, out of the way, kept for later use, a remark heard by the audience alone, or a short departure from the topic
core_image: 把挡在路中间的箱子挪到墙边，让出主路
scene: 搬运工把挡在门口的箱子挪到墙边，给推车让出一条通道。 He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
sceneCN: 这里 aside 是「到一边、在旁边」（第 1 个义项：移到旁边位置，让出中间）；句意为「他往旁边让开，好让推车过去」。画面中有门口的箱子、墙边与推车。

pos.zh: 副词：在旁边；到一边；撇开；留着

collocations.zh: 把某人拉到一边私下说

derivatives.zh: aside 的词根，义为「一边；侧面」，aside 即「在一边」
与 aside 同出 side，义为「在……旁边」

senses.title: To or on one side
senses.definition: to or toward one side, especially so as to clear the middle or make room
senses.definitionCN: 移向一侧，尤指为了空出中间或让出位置
senses.example: He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
senses.exampleCN: 他往旁边让开，好让推车过去。
senses.why: The word is a plus side: put something at the side, and the middle is left free.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是「在一边」：把东西放到侧边，中间便空了出来。

senses.title: Out of the way, kept for later
senses.definition: out of use or out of the way for now, often reserved for a later purpose
senses.definitionCN: 暂时不用或放到不碍事的地方，常为日后用途保留
senses.example: She set aside part of her salary each month.
senses.exampleCN: 她每月把一部分工资存到一边。
senses.why: Money moved aside is exactly money taken out of the main flow and kept.
senses.whyCN: 被挪到一边的钱，正是从主流程里取出来、留存下来的钱。

senses.title: A stage remark for the audience
senses.definition: in a play, a short speech spoken so that other characters cannot hear it but the audience can
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧中角色所说、其他人物听不见而观众听得见的短句
senses.example: His aside revealed what he really thought of the duke.
senses.exampleCN: 他的旁白透露了他对公爵的真实看法。
senses.why: The speech is moved aside from the stage conversation, heard on a separate track.
senses.whyCN: 这句话被挪到舞台对话的旁边，像走在另一条声轨上。

senses.title: A short departure from the topic
senses.definition: a brief remark that departs from the main subject before returning to it
senses.definitionCN: 短暂偏离主题、随后又回到主题的一句话
senses.example: As an aside, the author mentions her own childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 作为题外话，作者提到了自己的童年。
senses.why: The remark takes one step to the side of the main road and then comes back.
senses.whyCN: 这句话往主路旁边走了一步，然后又走回来。

intro.en: Aside is simply 'on side': a worn-down phrase built from side, the native word for a flank.
intro.cn: aside 就是「在一边」：由表示侧面的本土词 side 磨损而成的一个短语。

items.en: 「*sīdaz」 is reconstructed as 'wide, long, extensive', the source of the word for a broad flank.
items.cn: 「*sīdaz」被重构为「宽的、长的、广阔的」，是表示宽大侧面的那个词的来源。

items.en: Sīd meant 'side, flank, breadth', the word for the edge of a thing rather than its middle.
items.cn: sīd 意为「侧面、侧边、宽度」，指的是物体的边缘而非中央。

items.en: The phrase on side and its shortened forms meant 'at the side', often beside a road or a wall.
items.cn: on side 及其缩短形式意为「在一边」，常指在道路或墙的旁边。

items.en: Aside is recorded as a single adverb meaning 'to one side, out of the way'.
items.cn: aside 作为单个副词被记录下来，意为「向一边、让开」。

items.en: The reserved-use sense appears in set aside, and the theatre sense names a speech spoken off to the side.
items.cn: 「留作后用」义出现在 set aside 里，戏剧义则指挪到一旁说的话。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same side root; the near-meaning group gathers words for position, distance and digression.
note.cn: 形近组收建立在同一「侧边」词根上的词；近义组收表示位置、离开与离题的词。

entries.definition: The edge or flank of something, as opposed to its middle.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「侧面、侧边」，与中央相对。

entries.definition: At the side of, or next to.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「在……旁边」。

entries.definition: To accept or endure something, or to remain in a place.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「容忍、忍受」或「停留」。

entries.definition: Separated by distance or placed separately.
entries.definitionCN: 因距离而分开，或被单独放置。

entries.definition: At or to a distance from a place or person.
entries.definitionCN: 在或向离某地、某人有一段距离的地方。

entries.definition: A speech in a play in which a character alone speaks his or her thoughts.
entries.definitionCN: 戏剧中角色独自吐露心声的独白。

entries.definition: A temporary departure from the main subject in speech or writing.
entries.definitionCN: 说话或写作中暂时离开主题。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow aside from a box moved to the wall to money saved, a stage whisper and a digression.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子让 aside 从挪到墙边的箱子，走到存下的钱、舞台旁白与题外话。

normal.en: Aside is just 'on side': move it to the edge.
normal.cn: aside 就是「在一边」：把它挪到边缘。

normal.en: Step aside: the middle of the road opens.
normal.cn: 让到一边：路的中间就空出来了。

normal.en: Set aside money: keep it out of the main flow.
normal.cn: 把钱放到一边：让它离开主流程。

normal.en: A stage aside is spoken on a side track.
normal.cn: 舞台旁白走在另一条声轨上。

normal.en: As an aside: one step off the path, then back.
normal.cn: 作为题外话：往路边走一步，再走回来。

abstract.en: Everything aside is off to one side of something main.
abstract.cn: 所有 aside 都是主线的旁边。

abstract.en: Space, money, speech and topic all have sides.
abstract.cn: 空间、金钱、言语与话题都有「旁边」。

abstract.en: One small word covers both a physical step and a verbal one.
abstract.cn: 一个小词同时覆盖脚下的一步与嘴上的一步。

examples.en: He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
examples.cn: 他往旁边让开，好让推车过去。

examples.en: She set aside part of her salary each month.
examples.cn: 她每月把一部分工资存到一边。

examples.en: As an aside, the author mentions her own childhood.
examples.cn: 作为题外话，作者提到了自己的童年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿赛德」——阿赛德把挡路的箱子挪到墙边，自己也让到一边：在旁边

root: aside 就是「在一边」：古英语 sīd 意为「侧面、侧边」，短语 on side 磨损成 aside，指移到旁边或留在旁边。由这个空间义出发，它指把东西搁到一边不再使用，也指为日后保留；戏剧里把台词挪到舞台对话的旁边，就是观众听得见、剧中人听不见的旁白；说话时往主题旁边走一步又走回来，就是题外话。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses all come from one side-step: moving aside, keeping aside, speaking aside on stage, and wandering aside from the topic.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项都来自同一次「往旁边挪」：让到一边、留到一边、在舞台上旁白，以及从话题边上游开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a box blocking the doorway is moved to the wall, clearing the way.
core.cn: 核心意象：挡在门口的箱子被挪到墙边，路就空出来了。

branches.en: THE SPACE LINE: a physical move to one side.
branches.cn: 空间线：身体向旁边挪动。

branches.en: THE KEEPING LINE: something placed aside is reserved.
branches.cn: 留存线：放到一边的东西被留了下来。

branches.en: THE STAGE LINE: a speech moved off the main dialogue.
branches.cn: 舞台线：一句话被挪出主对话。

branches.en: THE TOPIC LINE: a remark walks beside the subject.
branches.cn: 话题线：一句话在主题旁边走。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY LINE: money aside and words aside are both kept out of the main flow.
branches.cn: 日常线：存到一边的钱与挪到一边的话，都离开了主流程。

intro.en: Aside is a worn-down phrase rather than a suffixed word; its family is the set of verb phrases it forms.
intro.cn: aside 是磨损而成的短语而非加后缀的词，它的词族是由它构成的动词短语。

latinIntro.en: Aside is native English; its side root has no Latin counterpart here.
latinIntro.cn: aside 是本土英语词，它的 side 词根在这里没有对应的拉丁词。

items.meaning: to one side, out of the way

items.example: The play is full of witty asides.
items.exampleCN: 这出戏里满是机智的旁白。

items.example: Aside from the rain, the trip was perfect.
items.exampleCN: 除了下雨，这次旅行很完美。

items.meaning: to reserve or put out of use
items.example: They set aside a day for repairs.

items.meaning: to place something out of the way
items.example: Put aside your doubts and start.
items.exampleCN: 把疑虑放到一边，开始吧。

items.meaning: to move out of the way, or to resign
items.example: The manager stepped aside for a younger rival.
items.exampleCN: 经理给一位更年轻的对手让了位。
她把那个警告随手拨开了。

items.meaning: to lead someone away for a private word
items.meaningCN: 把某人拉到一边私下说话
items.example: The coach took the player aside.
items.exampleCN: 教练把那名球员拉到一边。
